title: Utthita Parshvakonasana

sequence.action: Jump the legs open to the right and stand with the legs as much as five feet apart, as in Trikonasana, stretching out the arms tightly at the level of the chest, and swelling the chest.

Turn the right foot out, bend the knee completely, place the right hand by the side of the right foot, stretch the left arm straight out over the ear, and gaze at the fingertips. Puraka and rechaka should be done as much as possible.
Return to the position of the 1st vinyasa.
Repeat, as with the right leg, for the left leg.
Return to the position of the 1st vinyasa.

while_holding: Rechaka and puraka slowly and as much as possible.
benefits: Utthita Parshvakonasana purifies the ribs and lower abdomen, dissolves the bad fat at the waist, and softens the limbs so that subsequent asanas can be more easily practiced.
